questions.answer: Correct sequence: Step 3 (mix dough), Step 1 (shape bones), Step 4 (bake), Step 2 (brush butter and sugar).

questions.answer: It is placed on the ofrenda to welcome visiting spirits and nourish them after their long journey.

stimuli.label: Step A
stimuli.text: Card A: Shape small pieces of dough into bone-like strips and place them across the top of the round loaf before baking.

stimuli.label: Step B
stimuli.text: Card B: Remove the warm bread from the oven, brush it with melted butter, and sprinkle orange sugar generously over the crust.

stimuli.label: Step C
stimuli.text: Card C: Mix flour, warm milk, yeast, eggs, and sweet orange blossom water together in a large bowl to form rich dough.

stimuli.label: Step D
stimuli.text: Card D: Bake the decorated loaf in a hot oven until golden brown and fully cooked through.
